**Overall Sentiment:** 
The combined effect of declining assets, increasing losses, falling revenue, and shrinking shareholder equity strongly indicates a negative financial trajectory. The severity of the net loss and EPS decline weigh heavily on the sentiment score. The slight improvement in the current ratio and debt-to-equity ratio doesn't negate the overall negative trend. The confidence is high because the decline is evident in several key financial metrics.
